local_sources.strategy: Reuse exact local SHA256 matches recorded in local_source_matches.json; reverify actually referenced files during restoration/preflight. Additional cloud sources only are listed here.

minimal_acquisition.why_only_75pct_slices: Historical same-seed25/50 paid sets are nested in75. Restore ten75 arrays; derive twenty smaller arrays by exact row-ID join and verify original historical file hashes before numerical work.
minimal_acquisition.excluded_payloads: No document text, encoder weights, qrels, environment trees or unrelated archive members are needed.
minimal_acquisition.fullY_qualification: Only genuine paid slices are recovered; this does not recover/create or establish byte identity of missing full E5 Y.

restore_rules: Commit the asset-preflight protocol BEFORE deriving any25/50 arrays or anchor-target arrays. Restore/hash-check bytes only until that commit exists.
Verify downloaded whole archive against original verified receipt and embedded manifest before accepting any whitelisted member.
Extract only listed original paths; validate expected SHA256 and byte count.
Retain original absolute paths and historical receipt fields as provenance. Never relabel arrays as fresh encodings or new model fits.
Verify source-paid ID hashes, dtype, shape, unit rows and overlap consistency. Ordered anchors must be contained and extracted in exact declared order.
Derived25/50 slices must match exact historical file hashes; preserve and STOP on missing rows, mismatches or unknown serialization.
Two reused FiQA fits require unchanged historical50% ordered-top100 parity under committed preflight. Twenty-eight new FiQA fits are prospectively fresh fits, never recovered historical fits.
This manifest authorizes no numerical launch. Asset preflight requires its protocol commit; fitting/ranking/scoring require the committed full R3 scientific protocol and matching smoke.
